title: Past Simple: irregular verbs
grammarTitle: Неправильные глаголы — 40 самых важных глаголов Past Simple
grammarNote:
В английском языке большинство глаголов образуют прошедшее время добавлением -ed (работа, которую мы изучили в M11-3 и M11-g2). Но около 200 самых ЧАСТЫХ глаголов в английском — неправильные: у них особая форма прошедшего времени, которую нужно запомнить.

ПОЧЕМУ ЭТО ВАЖНО?
Вот случайное предложение на English из любого журнала или фильма:
"Yesterday she WENT to the market, BOUGHT some fruit, CAME home, MADE dinner, and SAW a film."
Если ты не знаешь went/bought/came/made/saw — ты не поймёшь НИЧЕГО из этого предложения!

ХОРОШАЯ НОВОСТЬ:
Эти глаголы имеют ПАТТЕРНЫ — группы с похожим изменением. Если выучить паттерн, легче запомнить сразу несколько глаголов!

📌 ГЛАВНОЕ ПРАВИЛО:
Форма прошедшего времени одинакова для ВСЕХ лиц — как и у правильных глаголов:
"I WENT · She WENT · We WENT · They WENT" — всегда went!

В отрицаниях и вопросах — БАЗОВАЯ ФОРМА (не паст!):
"She DIDN'T go." (не "didn't went"!)
"Did you GO to the market?" (не "did you went"!)

🔵 ГРУППА 1 — Глагол не меняется (base = past):
cut → cut · put → put · hit → hit · let → let · set → set · shut → shut
"I cut my finger yesterday." · "She put the book on the table."

🟢 ГРУППА 2 — Меняется только гласная (vowel change):
come → came · become → became · give → gave · take → took · make → made
eat → ate · drink → drank · run → ran · sit → sat · swim → swam
begin → began · win → won · sing → sang · stand → stood

🟡 ГРУППА 3 — Окончание меняется на -ght:
bring → brought · buy → bought · catch → caught
teach → taught · think → thought · fight → fought

🔴 ГРУППА 4 — Смешанные часто используемые:
go → WENT · have → HAD · do → DID · say → SAID
see → SAW · get → GOT · know → KNEW · find → FOUND
tell → TOLD · hear → HEARD · meet → MET · lose → LOST
pay → PAID · sell → SOLD · hold → HELD · feel → FELT
keep → KEPT · leave → LEFT · sleep → SLEPT · spend → SPENT
build → BUILT · send → SENT · mean → MEANT
write → WROTE · drive → DROVE · speak → SPOKE
break → BROKE · wake → WOKE · forget → FORGOT
fall → FELL · grow → GREW · fly → FLEW · throw → THREW
read → READ (пишется так же, но произносится /red/!)

grammarExtra.title: ① Топ-15 самых важных — знать наизусть!

rows.example: "Yesterday I WENT to the market." · "We WENT to the park on Saturday." · "She WENT home early."
"I HAD a great time." · "She HAD breakfast at 7:30." · "They HAD an exam on Friday."
"I DID my homework." · "What DID you do?" · "She DID a great job." · "He DID the dishes."
"She SAID hello." · "He SAID he was tired." · "What DID she say?" · "I SAID goodbye."
"I SAW a film last night." · "We SAW Madina at the market." · "Did you SEE that?" ← base!
"She GOT a new phone." · "I GOT up at 7." · "We GOT lost in the old city."
"She CAME home late." · "He CAME to the party." · "When DID you come?" ← base!
"Yerlan MADE rice with chicken." · "I MADE a mistake." · "She MADE tea for everyone."
"We TOOK a cable car up." · "I TOOK a photo." · "She TOOK her coat." · "He TOOK the test."
"I KNEW the answer." · "She KNEW Damir from school." · "We KNEW it was going to rain."
"He GAVE me directions." · "She GAVE a great lecture." · "They GAVE us free walnuts!"
"I FOUND my keys." · "Damir FOUND the mausoleum at last." · "We FOUND a great café."
"I THOUGHT it was Tuesday." · "She THOUGHT the exam was easy." · "We THOUGHT about it."
"She TOLD me the price." · "He TOLD us to cross the bridge." · "I TOLD you!"
"Nursultan BOUGHT a book for 1,800 tenge." · "I BOUGHT apples at the market." · "She BOUGHT a coat."

"He DRANK three cups of tea." · "We DRANK compote." · "I DRANK water all day."
"I RAN to the bus stop." · "She RAN past the library." · "He RAN every morning."

"She SWAM across the river." · "We SWAM in the Caspian Sea." · "I SWAM every morning."
"My team WON the debate!" · "She WON first place." · "Did they WIN? ← base!"
"Aibek SANG at the Music Club." · "We SANG together." · "She SANG beautifully."
"The lecture BEGAN at 9." · "It all BEGAN when I arrived in Uralsk." · "Rain BEGAN to fall."
"We STOOD in front of the cathedral." · "She STOOD at the gate." · "I STOOD for an hour."
"Kairat WROTE a letter to his friend." · "She WROTE her essay." · "I WROTE my plans."
"She SPOKE fluently." · "He SPOKE to the advisor." · "I SPOKE English for the first time."
"My alarm BROKE." (Ainur's story!) · "She BROKE a cup." · "The ice BROKE."
"I WOKE up at 7:30." · "She WOKE early." · "He WOKE to the sound of rain."
"She GREW up in Taraz." · "The company GREW fast." · "He GREW vegetables."
"She FLEW to Almaty." · "The plane FLEW over the mountains." · "Time FLEW by."
"She BROUGHT tea for everyone." · "He BROUGHT his guitar." · "What did she BRING? ← base!"
"He CAUGHT the bus." · "I CAUGHT a cold." · "She CAUGHT him cheating."

"They FOUGHT for their ideas." · "She FOUGHT hard to stay." · "We FOUGHT to finish."
"I HEARD music from the next room." · "She HEARD the news." · "Did you HEAR that? ← base!"
"We MET at the airport." · "I MET Damir in Taraz." · "When DID you meet? ← base!"
"I FELT tired but happy." · "She FELT relieved." · "He FELT the cold wind."
"I KEPT my promise." · "She KEPT the change." · "He KEPT studying."

"Nursultan SPENT 11,450 tenge." · "We SPENT two hours in the park." · "I SPENT time with family."
"Damir GOT lost in Taraz." · "I LOST my phone." · "She LOST the competition."
"I PAID by card." · "Tolegen PAID 230 tenge commission." · "She PAID for everyone."
"She HELD the door." · "He HELD the camera." · "We HELD a meeting."
Пишется READ, но произносится /red/! "I READ the article this morning." · "She READ it aloud."

grammarExtra.title: ④ Отрицание и вопросы — БАЗА после didn't и did

rows.example: ❌ "She didn't went." → ✅ "She DIDN'T GO." · ❌ "I didn't made." → ✅ "I DIDN'T MAKE." · ❌ "He didn't bought." → ✅ "He DIDN'T BUY."
❌ "Did you went?" → ✅ "Did you GO?" · ❌ "Did she saw?" → ✅ "Did she SEE?" · ❌ "Did he made?" → ✅ "Did he MAKE?"
В УТВЕРЖДЕНИИ: неправильная форма (went/saw/made). В ОТРИЦАНИИ и ВОПРОСЕ: БАЗОВАЯ форма (go/see/make) — неправильный паст здесь не нужен!

rows.form: Почему? Потому что did уже показывает прошедшее:
rows.example: "She WENT home." → паст форма нужна. "She DIDN'T GO home." → DID уже показывает прошедшее, поэтому GO (база).
"She DIDN'T GO to Almaty." · "He DIDN'T BUY the expensive book." · "Did she FIND the mausoleum?"
❌ "Did you WENT to the park?" → ✅ "Did you GO?" · ❌ "He didn't SAW the film." → ✅ "He didn't SEE the film."

grammarTip:
Как выучить 40 неправильных глаголов — 5 шагов:

① Выучи топ-10 СНАЧАЛА (они в 80% текстов):
   go→WENT · have→HAD · do→DID · say→SAID · see→SAW
   get→GOT · come→CAME · make→MADE · take→TOOK · know→KNEW

② Запомни паттерны группами:
   buy→BOUGHT · bring→BROUGHT · catch→CAUGHT → все на -ght
   feel→FELT · keep→KEPT · leave→LEFT · sleep→SLEPT → -ept/-elt
   eat→ATE · drink→DRANK · run→RAN · sit→SAT → гласная меняется

③ Главное правило НЕ путать:
   УТВЕРЖДЕНИЕ: "She WENT." ← паст форма
   ОТРИЦАНИЕ: "She DIDN'T GO." ← база!
   ВОПРОС: "Did she GO?" ← база!

④ Практика через наши уроки — ты уже видел эти глаголы:
   "Samal BOUGHT apples." · "Marat TOLD Zara to cross the bridge."
   "Nursultan SPENT 11,450 tenge." · "Damir FOUND the mausoleum."
   "Aliya GAVE directions." · "Kairat WROTE a letter."

⑤ Запомни через истории, не через список:
   "Yerlan MADE rice → gave it to friends → they ATE it → DRANK tea → SANG songs → WENT to sleep."

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct Past Simple form.
exercises.text: Yesterday Samal ___ to the market and ___ some apples and dried apricots.
exercises.hint: go → WENT (irregular!) · buy → BOUGHT (-ght pattern). ✅ "She WENT to the market and BOUGHT apples." These are two of the top-15 most important irregular verbs.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct Past Simple form.
exercises.text: Last Saturday, Timur's grandmother ___ (teach) him her special beshbarmak recipe.
exercises.hint: teach → TAUGHT (-ght pattern: teach/caught/brought/thought). ✅ "She TAUGHT him the recipe." NOT "teached"! Part of the -ght group.

exercises.text: "She didn't went to the library" is correct English.
exercises.hint: FALSE! After DIDN'T, always use the BASE form — not the past! ✅ "She DIDN'T GO to the library." — not "didn't went"! DID already shows past tense, so the verb goes back to base.

exercises.text: Nursultan ___ a book at the bookshop and ___ by card.
exercises.hint: find → FOUND (vowel change: i→ou) · pay → PAID (ay→aid). ✅ "He FOUND a book and PAID by card." Both irregular — found and paid are from the essential group.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct Past Simple form.
exercises.text: Aizat ___ (feel) surprised when she arrived in Uralsk — the weather was much warmer than Astana!
exercises.hint: feel → FELT (-elt pattern: feel/felt · keep/kept · leave/left · sleep/slept). ✅ "She FELT surprised." NOT "feeled"! Part of the -elt group.

exercises.text: You want to ask Kairat what he did at the weekend. Which is correct?
exercises.hint: "What DID you DO?" ✅ — DID (auxiliary, shows past) + subject (you) + BASE form (do). ❌ "did you WENT" — after did, always BASE form, never past! do → base form is "do".

exercises.instruction: Write the correct Past Simple form.
exercises.text: Madina ___ (take) a cable car up to Shymbulak and ___ (see) the whole city from above.
exercises.hint: take → TOOK (vowel change: a→oo). ✅ "She TOOK a cable car." · see → SAW (one of top-10: see→saw). "She SAW the city." Both essential irregular verbs from Module 12.

exercises.text: Damir visited Taraz last spring. Choose the correct version:
opts: He leaved Semey in the morning and goed to Taraz.
He left Semey in the morning and went to Taraz.
He left Semey in the morning and goed to Taraz.
He leaved Semey in the morning and went to Taraz.
exercises.correct: He left Semey in the morning and went to Taraz.
exercises.hint: leave → LEFT (not "leaved"! -ept/-elt group) · go → WENT (not "goed"! top-10 essential). ✅ "He LEFT Semey and WENT to Taraz." Both are classic irregular mistakes.
